_source: n8n 2.34.0 (monorepo package.json version; @n8n/n8n-nodes-langchain 2.34.0), packages/@n8n/nodes-langchain/nodes/agents/Agent/Agent.node.ts and V3/AgentV3.node.ts, .../agents/ToolsAgent/options.ts and prompt.ts, .../nodes/llms/LMChatOpenAi/LmChatOpenAi.node.ts, .../nodes/llms/LmChatOpenRouter/LmChatOpenRouter.node.ts, .../nodes/memory/MemoryBufferWindow/MemoryBufferWindow.node.ts and .../nodes/memory/descriptions.ts, .../nodes/tools/ToolHttpRequest/ToolHttpRequest.node.ts, .../nodes/tools/ToolWorkflow/ToolWorkflow.node.ts and v1/v2 versionDescription.ts, .../nodes/output_parser/OutputParserStructured/OutputParserStructured.node.ts and utils/descriptions.ts
_why: A transcription rather than a read. The reference checkout is read-only specification material and internal/guardrails forbids any build input — a test included — from reading a path under it, so the cluster mapping is checked against this committed record of what the reference said. Facts about the interchange format only: node type names, the typeVersions each node publishes, parameter keys and the option value strings a stored workflow contains. No n8n code.

nodes._promptNote: The user turn is split in two. `promptType` chooses the source and `text` carries it. At version 3.1 `promptType` has exactly two values; below it a third, `guardrails`, appears.
nodes._optionsNote: System message and iteration bound live inside the top-level `options` collection, not at the top level.

nodes._modelNote: `model` is a resourceLocator from typeVersion 1.2 upwards and a plain options string at 1.1 and below. Both shapes appear in stored workflows, so an importer has to read either.
nodes.baseURLOption: options.baseURL, default https://api.openai.com/v1, hidden from typeVersion 1.1 upwards

nodes._modelNote: `model` is a plain options string at every published version — never a resource locator, unlike the OpenAI node.

nodes._sessionNote: Version 1 stored a static `sessionKey` defaulting to chat_history. Version 1.1 changed that default to the sessionId expression. From 1.2 a `sessionIdType` selector chooses between the two, and `sessionKey` carries whichever applies.

nodes._promptNote: `promptType` chooses the user-message source: `auto` reads the chatInput field, `define` takes `text` plus the `messages.messageValues` fixedCollection rows.

nodes._nameNote: Like the HTTP Request Tool this node has no tool-name parameter: n8n derives the name the model calls from the node's own canvas name.
